description: Phase A deterministic demo set for the wind track (province Utrecht). Every basis grounds in the baseline run's cited NormCards, except the Natura 2000 setback which is explicitly hypothetical: setback distances are in the cite-or-abstain ledger (no verified provincial citation), so exploring them must say so.

scenarios.name: art. 6.3 lid 2 exception granted province-wide
scenarios.description: The Natuurnetwerk Nederland default exclusion (FR-W-14) is dropped: the discretionary lid-2 exception is assumed granted everywhere. Upper bound of the NNN policy space.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-W-14 (art. 6.3) excludes the NNN by default; lid 2 allows discretionary exceptions. This variant flips that documented choice province-wide — the exception itself is cited, its province-wide granting is the policy assumption.

scenarios.name: Stiltegebieden treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-W-12 (art. 9.28) is a conditional overlay in the baseline; this variant reclassifies it as a hard exclusion — the strict reading of the silence-area policy.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-W-12 (Stiltegebied, art. 9.28) conditions rather than excludes in the baseline formalization; this variant executes the strict reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: 500 m setback around Natura 2000 / ganzenrustgebieden
scenarios.description: Adds a 500 m buffer around the hard exclusions of FR-W-08. Setback/tip-height distances are in the cite-or-abstain ledger (no verified provincial citation), so this is explicitly hypothetical.

basis.rationale: National setback distances (Wgh/Bal, tip height) are abstained topics in the baseline run — no verified provincial citation exists, so no FormalRule carries them. This hypothetical explores what a 500 m setback would cost, flagged as not legally grounded.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: no citation exists for a setback distance; the abstention ledger records the topic. The underlying exclusion zones (Natura 2000, ganzenrustgebieden) are cited via NC-W-08.
